title: Repeated Read Coils with transaction, unit, and address drift
purpose: Exercise repeated request handling across three valid Read Coils transactions so a harness can compare first-versus-later processing behavior under stable framing but changing transaction identifiers, unit identifiers, addresses, and quantities.

messages.label: second read coils request at nearby address
third read coils request with alternate unit and larger quantity

expected_behavior: Each message should parse as an independent valid Read Coils request. A stateful target may service them normally or return bounded protocol exceptions depending on mapping, while the harness observes any inconsistent behavior across repeated transactions.
constraints_preserved: Every message uses a 7-byte MBAP header
Each MBAP length is 0006 for unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 01 requests use two-byte address and two-byte quantity fields
Messages form a repeated client-to-server sequence with valid framing
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe repeated-operation analogue only. It does not copy any reported write-related payload, does not introduce malformed lengths, and does not claim a crash condition.
